title: Cornbread
description: A golden, crumbly, slightly sweet Southern classic.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a bowl, mix dry ingredients.
In another bowl, mix wet ingredients.
Combine wet and dry, mix until just combined.
Pour into greased pan, bake 20–25 min.

title: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy and fast for weekend mornings.
ingredients: Butter or oil for the pan
instructions: Mash bananas; whisk in eggs and milk.
Stir in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side on a greased skillet.

title: Carne Asada
instructions: Whisk citrus, oil, garlic, cumin, chili, salt, pepper.
Marinate steak 30–60 min (room temp).
Grill high heat 3–4 min/side to medium-rare.
Rest 5 min; slice thinly against the grain.

title: Greek Ribs
description: Lemony, garlicky ribs with herby crust.
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper; coat ribs.
Bake covered 60 min; uncover and roast 15 min to brown.
Rest 5–10 min; slice and serve.

title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 cups mixed chopped veg (zucchini, green beans, etc.)
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, celery in oil 5–7 min; add garlic 30 sec.
Add tomatoes, broth; simmer 10 min.
Add mixed veg; simmer 10–15 min until tender.
Season and serve.
